title: Meeting in the middle — wave interference
description: Two waves. One sum. Move their phase and watch reinforcement turn into cancellation.

title: Spider — drive the open country
description: Drive the Spider, a raised six-wheeled scout carrier with hydropneumatic legs, across a generated watershed of rivers, gullies, cliffs, forests and cornfields. Free roam or fly wildfire, swiftwater rescue, forward pursuit and hostile crossing missions.
